test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**however**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**However**' is used to indicate a contrast or contradiction between two ideas.
 
• It is often used to introduce a counterargument or an alternative perspective.
 
• In this question, '**however**' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it suggests a contrast between the previous statement and the upcoming example.

 

​Correct Passage:__ *Twenty five years ago, few people realised that computers were about to become part of our daily lives. This short period of time has seen enormous changes, in business, education and public administration. Jobs which took weeks to complete in the past are now carried out in minutes. People who spent all day copying and checking calculations are now freed from these boring tasks. Students have become as familiar with hardware and software as their parents were with pencils and exercise books.*

*Computerisation of public records has enabled government departments to analyse the needs of citizens in detail. Some of us may wonder, **however**, life has really improved as a result of these changes. Many jobs disappeared, for example, when intelligent machines took over the work. Employers complain that clerical (5)________ have become dependent on calculators and cannot do simple arithmetic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, '**subsequently**', means 'afterwards' or 'later' and does not provide a contrast to the previous statement.
 
• Option 3, '**therefore**', means 'as a result' or 'consequently' and does not introduce a contrasting idea.
 
• Option 4, '**for instance**', is an example phrase and cannot be used to fill in the blank.
